episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling is  rookie at the Songhai School. With only 5 points of spiritual strength, he will have to face some problems.
episodes.title: Wang Ling's Triple Kill of Tuntian-ha

episodes.synopsis: Sun Rong and Chen Chao compete for the position of student president of the elite class. Will Sun Rong be able to pull it off with an enchantment?
episodes.title: A Fair and Just Class President Election

episodes.synopsis: In  the elite class, students learn how to make vitality pulls. Although the others use wacky ovens or cauldrons, Wang Ling decides to use a microwave.
episodes.title: How to Make an Origin Fostering Pill

episodes.synopsis: Sun Rong asks Wang Ling out on a special date. But what she doesn't know is that two killers will try to spoil her fun.
episodes.title: What Should I Do When the Goddess Forces Me on a Date

episodes.synopsis: The killers return to attack the school. But this time the school is prepared to face any threat. However, the attack of the three brothers is too powerful.
episodes.title: The Three Brothers of Shadow Stream

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling comes out first in the national power test and decides to infiltrate the system to change his score.
episodes.title: B++ is the Best Language in the World

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling will participate in the interschool sword competition with his friends against his rival, the 59th school.
episodes.title: 18 Tips for Maintaining a Spiritual Sword

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling doesn't want to participate in the competition and looks for the perfect moment to pretend to feel bad. When his amulet is about to break, Wang Ling's health is in danger of seriously deteriorating.
episodes.title: Like Master, Like Sword

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling needs his father to come to his aid or disaster is imminent. While he waits, Wang Ling runs into a dangerous female leader in the halls of School 59.
episodes.title: Master of the Shadow Stream

episodes.synopsis: The amulet is broken and now Wang Ling must control his emotions on his own. Meanwhile, Sun Rong is ready to help her most important friend.
episodes.title: Drive! Drive! Drive!

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling tries to keep a low profile now that his amulet is broken. At the Water Alter, Sun Rong confronts Tang Jingze.
episodes.title: The Aohai Rondo

episodes.synopsis: As Wang Ling begins to lose control, Toad jumps on top of him and absorbs his negative energy. At that moment, something amazing happens that gives Wang Ling the ability to use his strength without restraint from him.
episodes.title: A Dog is a Man's Best Friend

episodes.synopsis: Tang Jingze's spirit sword engages Sun Rong and destroys his weapon. Wang Ling's father implores them to stop the competition before someone gets hurt.
episodes.title: Let Us Burn!!

episodes.synopsis: The competition comes to an end. The leader of the League of Shadows attacks and Wang Ling finally loses control.
episodes.title: Accident

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling quickly realizes his mistake: not having stopped the leader of the League of Shadows sooner, so he decides to take the risk once more.
episodes.title: Helplessness of the Immortal King
